_que_es: Huevos por rareza y de evento (set E). Hoja 3x3 de íconos estilo HUD de los hits: python tools/imagegen.py prompt skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/huevos.json --ref skills/_shared/iconos/referencia-estilo.png

ia.prompt: Icons: nine eggs for the egg shop of a pet game, one per rarity, all with the same egg shape and size. Left to right and top to bottom: 1) a plain white egg with gray spots (common), 2) a green egg with a leaf pattern (uncommon), 3) a blue egg with wavy stripes (rare), 4) a purple egg with glowing crystal shards (epic), 5) a golden egg with orange flame patterns (legendary), 6) a hot-pink egg with a heart pattern and sparkles (mythic), 7) a black egg with a glowing rainbow crack (secret), 8) an orange pumpkin egg with a carved jack-o-lantern face (Halloween event), 9) an icy light-blue egg with snowflakes (winter event).
